revenue_scope: Worldwide COVID net product sales: the 'COVID' row of the net product sales by product table, which Moderna footnotes as including sales of Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE
why_separate: From the third quarter of 2025 the 'COVID' row carries the footnote 'Includes sales of Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE', so it is no longer Spikevax alone; the series (Spikevax-only definition) ends at 2025Q2 and this combined line begins at 2025Q3.
notes: Same issuer, same currency (USD millions) and same worldwide table as the end of the gold series; only the product definition widened. Rows 2025Q3, 2026Q1 and 2026Q2 are read from the quarter's own 10-Q as current; 2025Q4 is the 2025 10-K full year less the nine months in the Q3 2025 10-Q (the Q4 release prints no COVID row). Q4 2025 check: the 10-K RSV row gives 8 for the year and the Q3 10-Q gives 4 for nine months, and 642 + 4 = 646 against the 645 total net product sales printed for the quarter in the Q4 release (whole-million rounding of the inputs). Moderna prints no Spikevax-only or mNEXSPIKE-only sales figure in any document read: the 10-K, the three later 10-Qs and the Q3 2025 and Q4 2025 releases name mNEXSPIKE only in the footnote and in prose without a sales figure.
search_log: Each 10-Q/10-K 'net product sales by product' table: rows COVID (1), RSV, Net product sales; the footnote text 'Includes sales of Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE' appears in all four filings; no Spikevax or mNEXSPIKE row exists in any table (HTML tables searched for rows beginning Spikevax, mNEXSPIKE, COVID)
Q3 2025 release table prints only Net product sales (973 | 1,820 | 1,172 | 2,171); Q4 2025 release prints Net product sales (645 | 938 | 1,818 | 3,109) and no product split
Quarterly COVID figures were checked against the prior-year columns of the following 10-Qs (Q1 2026 10-Q prints 84 for Q1 2025, Q2 2026 10-Q prints 114 for Q2 2025), consistent with the gold series
